label: An efficient cause of a thing's esse is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to that thing
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: for all c and x, if c is an efficient cause of x's esse (EfficientlyCausesEsse, tenseless: originating or sustaining), then c is simply prior to x (PriorSimply, DEF-SIMPLE-PRIORITY). It is the tenseless counterpart of STMT-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-IS-PRIOR-TO-EFFECT (e078f07b), not that statement: e078f07b's claim and derivation concern the secunda via's here-and-now efficient causes, whose per se causes act together. A merely originating agent of x's esse that no longer acts is covered here and not there; whether such an agent is simply prior to x is part of what this premise asserts.
